notes: SCOPE, stated precisely to avoid an overclaim: MiraclePlus names a Xuhui platform whose full title is the SME AI compute service and industrial innovation incubation platform. The instrument read here is the district 2026 compute-voucher notice, which is the district-level scheme of the same family but is not proven to be the exact contract the MiraclePlus page refers to. What the voucher notice does establish first-party is the applicant class for Xuhui compute money, which is legal persons and organisations with a business licence, and that is the fact a reader needs. The platform-build side (first-year budget CNY 30,000,000, at least 30 projects a year) comes from a third-party reproduction of the guideline and is reported, not documented. Recorded because a reader following the co-funder trail lands here and must be told this purse is closed to individuals while the MiraclePlus intake in front of it is not. Do not merge the two: MiraclePlus allocates its own credits to individual researchers, and the Xuhui voucher reimburses corporate spend.
